# Robert Allen Bautista

> Robert Allen Bautista is a tax preparer and accountant based in Kansas City, Missouri, and the author of The Small Business Tax Code, Unlocked and The Small Business Tax Calendar. He holds an M.S. and B.S. in Accounting from Purdue University Global, holds an active PTIN, is a CPA candidate, and works in English and Spanish.
